# netactuate_router_ipsec (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages the router level IPsec configuration on a cloud router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_ipsec" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.

### Optional

- `esp_encryption` (String) ESP encryption algorithm.
- `esp_hash` (String) ESP hash algorithm.
- `esp_lifetime_seconds` (Number) ESP SA lifetime in seconds (30-86400).
- `ike_dh_group_number` (Number) Diffie-Hellman group number.
- `ike_do_auto_renegotiation` (Boolean) Auto-reconnect on peer loss.
- `ike_encryption` (String) IKE encryption algorithm.
- `ike_hash` (String) IKE hash algorithm.
- `ike_key_exchange_version` (Number) IKE version (1 or 2).
- `ike_lifetime_seconds` (Number) IKE SA lifetime in seconds (0-86400).
- `ike_prf` (String) Pseudo-random function.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_ipsec.example 12345
```
